articles.title: Sensex Crashes 1,677 Points as Trump Declares Iran Deal 'Over' — Oil Surges, Rupee Hits One-Month Low
articles.excerpt: Indian markets suffered their worst single-day fall in three months after the US-Iran ceasefire collapsed, sending Brent crude past $79, the rupee to 95.55, and the India VIX up 26 percent — a triple blow for NRI investors watching from abroad.
articles.image_caption: The Bombay Stock Exchange building in Mumbai, home to the Sensex index
articles.nri_angle: India imports 85% of its crude oil — the Iran-driven spike threatens higher inflation, a weaker rupee, and delayed rate cuts, directly impacting NRI remittances, mutual fund returns, and property investment plans.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India's Largest Mutual Fund House Is Going Public — and Abu Dhabi and Singapore's Sovereign Funds Are Already In
articles.excerpt: SBI Funds Management's $1.2 billion IPO kicks off a wave of blockbuster listings that could raise $50 billion in the second half of 2026.
articles.image_caption: State Bank of India headquarters in Mumbai
articles.nri_angle: NRI investors can participate in the SBI Funds IPO through Indian demat accounts; the listing is a proxy for India's mutual fund revolution driven by millions of SIP investors.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India's Private Banks Just Posted Their Strongest Quarter in Over a Year — and Wall Street Is Raising Its Bets
articles.excerpt: HDFC Bank, Axis Bank, and YES Bank report double-digit loan growth in Q1 FY27, lifting the Sensex past 78,200 and extending the market's longest winning streak of 2026
articles.image_caption: The Bombay Stock Exchange building in Mumbai, home to the Sensex benchmark
articles.nri_angle: Indian bank stocks are among the most popular NRI equity positions, and Q1 FY27 updates showing accelerating loan growth and record foreign bond inflows signal a strengthening investment case for diaspora capital.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk
